content_sections.heading: Sainik School Kodagu Recruitment 2026 - Important Links

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment drive is being conducted by Sainik School Kodagu located in Kushalnagar, Karnataka to fill multiple regular and contractual teaching and support positions.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available under this notification?
faq.answer: There are a total of 7 vacancies announced across various posts including PGT Physics, TGT English, TGT Hindi, TGT Social Science, Nursing Sister, and Ward Boy.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the offline application form?
faq.answer: The last date for the receipt of filled-in offline application forms along with all necessary attachments at the school office is 6 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application mode for Sainik School Kodagu Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply through offline mode only. Applications submitted by hand or through unapproved modes will be summarily rejected by the administration.

faq.question: Q5. Where should I send my filled application form?
faq.answer: Applications must be sent via Registered Post or Speed Post to The Principal, Sainik School Kodagu, Village & Post: Kudige, Taluk: Kushalnagar, Kodagu District, Karnataka – 571 232.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for General and OBC candidates?
faq.answer: General and OBC category candidates are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 500/- through a Demand Draft drawn in favor of The Principal, Sainik School Kodagu.

faq.question: Q7. Are SC and ST candidates eligible for any fee concession?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates belonging to SC and ST categories have a reduced application fee of Rs. 350/- which must be paid via Demand Draft along with their application form.

faq.question: Q8. What are the educational qualifications required for the Ward Boy post?
faq.answer: Applicants for the Ward Boy position must have passed Matriculation or an equivalent examination from a recognized board along with fulfillment of age criteria.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process comprises a Written Examination, a Skill Test and Interview, and a Class Demonstration or Practical Test depending upon the specific post applied for.

faq.question: Q10. Are the positions permanent or contractual?
faq.answer: The PGT and TGT positions are regular appointments, whereas the Nursing Sister and Ward Boy positions are offered on a contractual basis as per the school rules.
